question: Among living patients whose last names begin with "A" and who each have exactly one distinct condition, which eight conditions have the highest number of different active medications prescribed to any single patient, and what are their corresponding codes?
sql:
-- For each condition, find the max number of distinct active meds any single patient has
WITH living_patients AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient`
  WHERE (deceased.boolean IS NULL OR deceased.boolean = FALSE)
    AND name[OFFSET(0)].family LIKE 'A%'
),
patient_condition_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.subject.patientId,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) as num_distinct_conditions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
  WHERE c.subject.patientId IN (SELECT id FROM living_patients)
  GROUP BY c.subject.patientId
),
single_condition_patients AS (
  SELECT patientId
  FROM patient_condition_counts
  WHERE num_distinct_conditions = 1
),
single_condition_info AS (
  SELECT 
    c.subject.patientId,
    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as condition_code,
    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
  WHERE c.subject.patientId IN (SELECT patientId FROM single_condition_patients)
),
patient_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    mr.subject.patientId,
    mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as med_code,
    mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as med_display,
    mr.medication.codeableConcept.text as med_text
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr
  WHERE mr.status = 'active'
    AND mr.subject.patientId IN (SELECT patientId FROM single_condition_patients)
),
patient_condition_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    sci.condition_code,
    sci.condition_display,
    sci.patientId,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(pm.med_code, '|', pm.med_text)) as num_active_meds
  FROM single_condition_info sci
  JOIN patient_meds pm ON sci.patientId = pm.patientId
  GROUP BY sci.condition_code, sci.condition_display, sci.patientId
),
condition_max_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    condition_code,
    condition_display,
    MAX(num_active_meds) as max_active_meds
  FROM patient_condition_meds
  GROUP BY condition_code, condition_display
)
SELECT 
  condition_code,
  condition_display,
  max_active_meds
FROM condition_max_meds
ORDER BY max_active_meds DESC, condition_code ASC
LIMIT 8
